name: shots/torpedo
description: Photon Torpedo v2 (w15-WEAPONLOOK2): hand-drawn native finned capsule — pale-nose cyan flank over a white core row, dark hull cap and twin tail fins at both rows' ends; the violet exhaust shimmer swaps in the run frame. A finned projectile, not a straight bar — separates it from basic, twin and missile (w15-WEAPONLOOK § 6).
